card.name: Verbs of making or reducing before a result
card.fires_on: Verbs like make, reduce and reduction, and similar words, that come right before the thing being changed (a risk, a diagnosis, a symptom). Seen in treatment and warning text.

modes.label: make / making
modes.description: The verb make used for producing a diagnosis or an improved state.
modes.example: Treatment may help<< make>> the skin look better.

modes.label: reduce / reduction
modes.description: Reduce or reduction before a risk, recurrence or drug effect.
modes.example: Steps to<< reduce>> the risk of and manage metformin
